verdict.rationale: Okta documents extensive Admin Management APIs, SCIM provisioning, event hooks, and an official MCP server that lets AI agents perform many admin operations (create users, manage groups, query login events, list unused apps) via natural language wrapping the API — strong evidence of broad API coverage for management tasks. However there is no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity, and openness-signal probes (llms.txt, docs-md, openapi spec) all returned 404s, suggesting the full API surface isn't easily discoverable or guaranteed complete. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or comprehensive OpenAPI spec confirming every UI action has an API equivalent, and independent verification of full coverage beyond MCP server examples.
